turns.assessment: The simultaneous interruption of a very large set of services whose working paths all transit S08, including many services on different optical degrees and channels, localizes the failure to the common OTN switching function at S08. The unchanged line-interface, OCM, amplifier, power, OSNR, BER, DGD, and SOP telemetry strongly argues against an optical-layer failure. SNCP services either went down or switched to protection, consistent with loss of their working ODUs through the S08 switch fabric.

proposals.rationale: Every affected working path depends on otn.S08, and a switch-fabric failure interrupts every ODU cross-connected through it. The broad, simultaneous multi-channel impact with no optical telemetry change is the expected signature.

The S08 ROADM is also common, but one WSS input-port failure should affect only channels arriving on one degree. The affected services use many S08 degrees, and optical monitors show no associated signal loss.
